title: Witness launch driver: ledgered top-level launches per arm set, bundles bound via rso.binding, seed bookkeeping
objective: rso/witness/run_witness.py: a CLI that runs a registered list of (subject genome file, arm, seed list) as ONE ledgered top-level launch per bundle against a given ledger + contract (Ledger.from_contract), using rso/witness/ares_client.py; writes the bundle (receipts, inventory with parent_run_id + receipt_sha256, MANIFEST.json with launch_run_id, run.json); a subcommand that runs ares.search.run for a registered subject config and records the champion genome bytes, its sha256, the run receipt and EVERY episode seed the GA drew (for PREREG_DRAFT s3 exclusion), without printing or storing fitness beyond what ares.search.run itself returns into the file.
parent_objective: native witness preparation (opens as its own campaign only if C-009 closes)
problem: Plumbing tests only, in a temp dir, with a tiny registered config (e.g. P=4, G=1) on a RANDOM population and 2-4 seeds: the bundle binds (binding_reasons == [] for every receipt), the launch is one TOP_LEVEL row, a second run does not reuse the first launch, the seed record is complete. Do not compute or print any accuracy/retention statistic; do not run the registered subject configs (P=128, G=120): that is C-010's first act after the preregistration freezes.
non_goals: No subject evolution; no witness predicate on Ares output; no accuracy/retention/reward number for any arm or control
No change to rso/binding or the slice evidence plane (BX6)
evidence_required: statement: no registered subject run, no statistic computed

acceptance.condition: all evidence_required items; no outcome observed
